scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: Oberon typed function
checks.code: MODULE Main; IMPORT Out; PROCEDURE Square(n:INTEGER):INTEGER; BEGIN RETURN n*n END Square; BEGIN Out.Int(Square(7),0); Out.Ln END Main.

checks.name: Oberon array fold and edited source
checks.code: MODULE Main; IMPORT Out; VAR v:ARRAY 3 OF INTEGER; i,s:INTEGER; BEGIN v[0]:=3;v[1]:=4;v[2]:=5;s:=0;FOR i:=0 TO 2 DO s:=s+v[i] END;Out.Int(s,0);Out.Ln END Main.

checks.name: Oberon records pointers and GC
checks.code: MODULE Main; IMPORT Out; TYPE Box=POINTER TO RECORD value:INTEGER END; VAR p:Box; BEGIN NEW(p);p.value:=6;Out.Int(p.value*2,0);Out.Ln END Main.

checks.name: Oberon multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code: MODULE Main; IMPORT In,Out; VAR s:ARRAY 4096 OF CHAR; BEGIN In.Line(s);ASSERT(In.Done);Out.String(s);Out.Ln;In.Line(s);ASSERT(In.Done);Out.String(s);Out.Ln END Main.
